en.tagline: French marketing suite: email, SMS, WhatsApp and CRM
en.description: Brevo (formerly Sendinblue, from Paris) combines email marketing, SMS, WhatsApp campaigns, a simple CRM and chat, with AI help for copy. You pay by emails sent rather than number of contacts.
bestFor: SMBs that prefer a European provider
limitations: Marketing automation starts on the Standard plan
